gpu_workload.accounting: all native committed prefill/decode for root, candidates, normal reducer, pressure and continuation; normal ready time, normal completion time, policy CPU cost and full foreground/background latency
gpu_workload.arrivals: candidate prefixes and root are constructed in common order; the normal reducer starts, then pressure is submitted after exactly four normal-output engine steps in every arm; the actual follow-up starts only from normal body dispatch_index
gpu_workload.capacity: two 2048-token candidates consume 256 blocks; 64 extra blocks are fixed before outcomes for the active normal prompt/output; the 2048-token pressure request must evict candidate cache
gpu_workload.contention: authored fixed causal pressure injection for mechanism isolation, not natural multi-branch contention
gpu_workload.control: the first carrier integer is observed by output step four before pressure victim selection and before the normal object completes; APC and structural parse the identical carrier but ignore the hint
gpu_workload.quality: actual follow-up is dispatched by normal body dispatch_index; exact JSON integer answer; at least 10/12 passes per method and seed with zero paired inline regression
gpu_workload.reset: release all captured checkpoints and reset prefix cache between episodes

historical_v3: valid historical E2E_UTILITY_NO_GO; unchanged and not rerun
hypothesis: A necessary normal reducer output can expose its actual follow-up choice early enough to improve native cache retention without a separate intent inference.
scope: authored inline-intent mechanism only; real natural-contention pilot is outside this scope
stopping: functional failure stops the matrix; any valid per-seed gate failure is terminal SCIENTIFIC_NO_GO; instrumentation faults are repaired and the same frozen protocol rerun
